# AEO Checker

> AEO Checker is an Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and AI Search Visibility platform. It monitors how brands appear in AI-generated answers from ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity, detects traffic leaks (brand mentions without website citations), and generates prioritized algorithmic fix playbooks.

## Canonical URLs
- Website: https://aeo-checker.com
- Public Reports: https://aeo-checker.com/report
- Free AI Crawler Audit: https://aeo-checker.com/tools/ai-crawler-audit
- Free llms.txt Generator: https://aeo-checker.com/tools/llms-generator
- Industry Benchmarks: https://aeo-checker.com/industries
- Competitor Comparisons: https://aeo-checker.com/compare
- Pricing & Plans: https://aeo-checker.com/pricing
- AEO Resources & Documentation: https://aeo-checker.com/resources

## Core Capabilities
- AI Visibility Score (0-100): Weighted calculation across mention frequency, citation rate, and position in AI answers.
- Traffic Leak Detection: Identifies buyer prompts where an AI assistant recommends a brand by name but fails to provide a clickable hyperlink.
- 23 AI Crawler Matrix: Live deterministic verification of robots.txt and /llms.txt against GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, ByteSpider, and 18 other AI bots.
- Platform Optimization Playbooks: Algorithmic guidance tailored to ChatGPT Search, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, and Bing Copilot.
- Share of Voice Benchmarking: Real-time market share measurement against direct competitors in conversational queries.

- [Full Text Summary](https://aeo-checker.com/llms-full.txt): Complete platform architecture and prompt auditing methods.
